scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm db:migrate && turbo run dev
scripts.db:seed: turbo run build --filter=@zaafran/media --filter=@zaafran/domain && pnpm --dir packages/db db:seed

scripts.test:authz: turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' && vitest run --coverage.enabled=false apps/api/test/policy.test.ts apps/api/test/auth-http.test.ts apps/api/test/merchant-http.test.ts apps/api/test/menu-category-http.test.ts apps/api/test/menu-item-http.test.ts apps/api/test/menu-option-group-http.test.ts apps/api/test/menu-price-http.test.ts apps/api/test/media-reservation-http.test.ts apps/api/test/media-upload-http.test.ts apps/api/test/menu-import-http.test.ts apps/api/test/menu-preview-http.test.ts apps/api/test/merchant-hours-http.test.ts apps/api/test/merchant-hours-preview-http.test.ts apps/api/test/merchant-staff-http.test.ts apps/api/test/admin-moderation-http.test.ts apps/api/test/merchant-profile-photos-http.test.ts apps/api/test/billing-read-http.test.ts apps/api/test/billing-write-http.test.ts apps/api/test/merchant-promotions-http.test.ts apps/api/test/platform-http.test.ts apps/api/test/ramadan-http.test.ts apps/api/test/discovery-http.test.ts apps/api/test/public-feed-http.test.ts apps/api/test/discovery-search-http.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: turbo run build --filter=@zaafran/web && pnpm --filter @zaafran/web build:design && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:auth: turbo run build --filter=@zaafran/web --filter=@zaafran/api --filter=@zaafran/worker && playwright test --config e2e/auth.config.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:mobile && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @zaafran/api openapi:check && pnpm test:int && pnpm knip && pnpm depcruise && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high && pnpm trace
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:e2e:auth && pnpm test:visual && pnpm test:a11y && pnpm test:lighthouse && pnpm test:mutation
